opening.text: I've got pain that came on slowly. It's tender and burning, and I'd rate it a 7 out of 10. I also have a cough and I've been coughing up blood. I have a fever. I smoke cigarettes, and in the past two weeks I've been around someone with similar symptoms. I also go to or work in a daycare.
